observations: Photo 0: Black Xbox One X console with a gold and black controller on top. 'XBOX' logo visible on front left. Console sits on a blue surface, background shows blue cabinets with laptops inside.
Photo 1: Same console from a different angle, showing front vents and side ports. Controller is on top. Background same blue cabinets.
Photo 2: Console from front-right angle, showing 'XBOX' logo and controller. Background same blue cabinets.
All photos show the console and controller in a store setting with 'Hilife Stores LTD' signage.
No games, cables, or power supply visible in any photo.
No model number or serial number visible on console or controller in any photo.

identity.kind: Xbox One X console with one controller

claims.claim: Uk used Microsoft Xbox One X 1TB storage
claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.
One controller is visible on top of the console in all three photos.
No games are visible in any photo. Cannot verify availability remotely.
Background shows blue cabinets with laptops inside, consistent with a retail store environment.
Subjective claim; cannot verify value remotely.

risks.risk: Console may not be 1TB storage as claimed
risks.proof: Photo of the console's system settings screen showing storage capacity, or a photo of the console's label with model and storage info.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as lower storage model (e.g., 500GB) or as unverified storage.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have hardware issues
risks.proof: Video of the console powering on, booting up, and running a game or menu.

risks.risk: Controller may be non-functional or have damage
risks.proof: Video of the controller connecting to the console and responding to inputs.

risks.risk: Console may be stolen or have warranty issues
risks.proof: Photo of the console's serial number and a copy of the original purchase receipt or warranty card.
risks.if_unproven: Priced with discount for potential warranty or legal issues.

proof_requests: Photo of the console's system settings screen showing storage capacity.
Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Video of the controller connecting and working with the console.
Photo of the console's serial number and any warranty or purchase documentation.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
